group-mock-gd-2026-m1-grammar-fill.overview: 记叙文。英国摄影师 Jord Hammond 自 2015 年起把重庆当作第二故乡，用行走与镜头理解城市，并把摄影变成向世界讲述中国日常的方式。

q-mock-gd-2026-m1-056.reason: Since then 把时间从 2015 拉到现在，谓语用现在完成时 has regarded。

evidence.signalText: Jord Hammond is a British photographer
evidence.relation: 主语 he 为第三人称单数，助动词用 has。

q-mock-gd-2026-m1-056.teachingNote: 见到 Since then 先判完成时，再配 has + 过去分词。

q-mock-gd-2026-m1-057.reason: captures 已是谓语，空处作伴随状语，用现在分词 revealing。

evidence.relation: 句中已有谓语 captures，reveal 不能再作谓语。

evidence.signalText: a China that is raw, up-close and deeply human

q-mock-gd-2026-m1-057.teachingNote: 逗号后动词空，句中已有谓语时走非谓语，主动用 -ing。

q-mock-gd-2026-m1-058.reason: 修饰形容词 different，complete 应变副词 completely。

evidence.relation: 空后 different 为形容词，前用副词。

q-mock-gd-2026-m1-058.teachingNote: a ____ different + 名词，空填副词。

q-mock-gd-2026-m1-059.reason: 句首表目的，he started 已是谓语，用不定式 To understand。

evidence.signalText: the city, he started going on long walks
evidence.relation: 逗号后出现完整主谓，句首动词作目的状语。

q-mock-gd-2026-m1-059.teachingNote: 句首动词 + 逗号 + 主谓，优先 to-do 表目的。

q-mock-gd-2026-m1-060.reason: 空后 started as... soon became 缺主语，What 引导主语从句。

evidence.signalText: started as a way to feel more comfortable soon became a daily habit
evidence.relation: 两个谓语需要一个主语从句来充当主语。

q-mock-gd-2026-m1-060.teachingNote: ____ started as ... became 是主语从句，填 What。

q-mock-gd-2026-m1-061.reason: explore、make sense of、connect 三个不定式并列，中间用 and。

evidence.signalText: a way to explore, make sense of the surroundings,
evidence.relation: to 后已有两个动词短语，再接 connect，需并列连词。

q-mock-gd-2026-m1-061.teachingNote: 三个动词短语并列时，最后一项前填 and。

q-mock-gd-2026-m1-062.reason: were 后缺表语形容词，remark 转为 remarkable。

evidence.relation: 系动词 were 后接形容词。

q-mock-gd-2026-m1-062.teachingNote: were ____. 给动词提示时做分词/形容词转换，这里是 -able。

q-mock-gd-2026-m1-063.reason: deepened his 后需名词，appreciate 转为 appreciation。

evidence.signalText: for China’s cultural and geographic diversity
evidence.relation: appreciation for 为常见名词搭配。

q-mock-gd-2026-m1-063.teachingNote: his ____ for... 给动词时转名词。

q-mock-gd-2026-m1-064.reason: 破折号后缺主语，回指 photography，用 it。

evidence.signalText: photography could be more than a personal hobby
could be a form of storytelling
evidence.relation: 空后是谓语，空处填主语代词。

q-mock-gd-2026-m1-064.teachingNote: hobby— ____ could be 回指 photography，填 it。

q-mock-gd-2026-m1-065.reason: show ... to people 表示向世界各地的人展示中国日常生活。

evidence.relation: show sth to sb 缺介词 to。

q-mock-gd-2026-m1-065.teachingNote: show A ____ B 表示展示给谁，填 to。
